```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(arm)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(car)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
library(gridExtra)
```

## Import the data
```{r}
original_data = read.csv("EOTST211_2033_individual.csv")
# summary(original_data)
```

Preparing dataset
```{r}
# create a new dataset to work with
data = original_data

# remove NSID
data = subset(data, select = - NSID)

# set negative numbers as NA
data[data < 0] = NA
```


### Numeric turns to categorical variables
Given that many of the variables are actually categorical, to make it clear, replace numbers with the actual levels of the corresponding variables. 
```{r}
data$W1condur5MP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1condur5MP == 1, "yes", 
                          ifelse(data$W1condur5MP == 2, "no", NA)))

data$W1hea2MP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1hea2MP == 1, "yes", 
                                 ifelse(data$W1hea2MP == 2, "no", NA)))
data$W1usevcHH = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1usevcHH == 1, "yes", 
                                  ifelse(data$W1usevcHH == 2, "no", NA)))
data$W1wrkfullmum = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1wrkfullmum == 1, "working full-time", 
                                     ifelse(data$W1wrkfullmum == 2, "working part-time", 
                                            ifelse(data$W1wrkfullmum == 3, 
                                                   "currently not working", NA))))
# which(is.na(data$W1IndSchool))
data$W1IndSchool = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1IndSchool == 0, "maintained", "independent"))

data$W1famtyp2 = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1famtyp2 == 0, "No", 
                                  ifelse(data$W1famtyp2 == 1, "Yes", NA)))
data$W1truantYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1truantYP == 1, "Yes", 
                                   ifelse(data$W1truantYP == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W1alceverYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1alceverYP == 1, "Yes", 
                                    ifelse(data$W1alceverYP == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W1bulrc = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1bulrc == 1, "Yes", 
                                ifelse(data$W1bulrc == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W1disabYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1disabYP == 1, 
                                  "Has disability & schooling affected", 
                                  ifelse(data$W1disabYP == 2, 
                                         "Has disability, but schooling not affected", 
                                         ifelse(data$W1disabYP == 3, 
                                                "No disability or longstanding illness",
                                                NA))))
data$W2disc1YP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W2disc1YP == 1, "Yes", 
                                  ifelse(data$W2disc1YP == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W6JobYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W6JobYP == 1, "Yes", 
                                ifelse(data$W6JobYP == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W6UnivYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W6UnivYP == 1, "Yes", 
                                 ifelse(data$W6UnivYP == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W6gcse = as.factor(ifelse(data$W6gcse == 1, "5+", 
                               ifelse(data$W6gcse == 2, "1-4", 
                                      ifelse(data$W6gcse == 4, NA, "None"))))
data$W6als = as.factor(ifelse(data$W6als == 1, "2+", 
                              ifelse(data$W6als == 2, "1", 
                                     ifelse(data$W6als == 3, NA, "None"))))
data$W6OwnchiDV = as.factor(ifelse(data$W6OwnchiDV == 1, "Yes", 
                                   ifelse(data$W6OwnchiDV == 2, "No", NA)))
data$W8DDEGP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8DDEGP == 1, "First or higher degree",
                                ifelse(data$W8DDEGP == 0, "No degree", NA)))
data$W8DWRK = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8DWRK == 1, "Currently employed", 
                               ifelse(data$W8DWRK == 2, "Not currently employed", NA)))
data$W8CMSEX = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8CMSEX == 1, "Male", "Female"))

data$W2depressYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W2depressYP == 1, "Not at all", ifelse(data$W2depressYP == 2, "No more than usual", ifelse(data$W2depressYP == 3, "Rather more than usual", ifelse(data$W2depressYP == 4, "Much more than usual", NA)))))

data$W8QMAFI = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8QMAFI == 1, "Living comfortably", 
                                ifelse(data$W8QMAFI == 2, "Doing alright",
                                       ifelse(data$W8QMAFI == 3, "Just about getting by",
                                              ifelse(data$W8QMAFI == 4, 
                                                     "Finding it quite difficult",
                                                     "Finding it very difficult")))))

data$W8TENURE = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8TENURE == 1, "Own - outright", ifelse(data$W8TENURE == 2, "Own - buying with help of mortg or loan", ifelse(data$W8TENURE == 3, "Part rent/mortgage (shared/equity own)", ifelse(data$W8TENURE == 4, "Rent inc Housing Ben/Lcl Housing Allow", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 5, "Rent-free inc rels/friend exc squatting", ifelse(data$W8TENURE == 6, "Squatting", ifelse(data$W8TENURE == 8, "Other arrangement inc board to parents", NA))))))))

data$W1heposs9YP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1heposs9YP == 1, "Very likely", 
                          ifelse(data$W1heposs9YP == 2, "Fairly likely",
                                 ifelse(data$W1heposs9YP == 3, "Not very likely",
                                        ifelse(data$W1heposs9YP == 4, 
                                               "Not at all likely", NA)))))

data$W1wrk1aMP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 1, "Full-time paid employee (30 or more hours a week)", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 2, "Part-time paid employee (under 30 hours a week)", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 3, "Full-time self-employed", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 4, "Part-time self-employed", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 5, "Unemployed and seeking work", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 6, "Full-time education", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 7, "On a government scheme for employment training", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 8, "Temporarily sick/ disabled (if temporarily off sick from job", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 9, "Permanently sick/ disabled", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 10, "Looking after home/ family", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 11, "Retired from work altogether", ifelse(data$W1wrk1aMP == 12, "Other answers", NA)))))))))))))

data$W1InCarHH = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1InCarHH == 1, "Private household", ifelse(data$W1InCarHH == 2, "Hotel/ B&B", ifelse(data$W1InCarHH == 3, "Institution", ifelse(data$W1InCarHH == 4, "Other answers", NA)))))


data$W1hous12HH = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 1, "Owned outright", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 2, "Being bought on a mortgage/ bank loan", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 3, "Shared ownership (owns & rents property)", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 4, "Rented from a Council or New Town", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 5, "Rented from a Housing Association", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 6, "Rented privately", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 7, "Rent free", ifelse(data$W1hous12HH == 8, "Some other arrangement", NA)))))))))


data$W1marstatmum = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 1, "Single, that is, never married", ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 2, "Married and living with husband or wife", ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 3, "Living with a partner", ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 4, "Married and separated from husband or wife", ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 5, "Divorced", ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 6, "Widowed", ifelse(data$W1marstatmum == 7, "Other", NA))))))))

data$W8DACTIVITYC = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 1, "Employee - in paid work", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 2, "Self employed", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 3, "In unpaid/voluntary work", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 4, "Unemployed", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 5, "Education: School/college/university", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 6, "Apprenticeship", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 7, "On gov't scheme for employment training", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 8, "Sick or disabled", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 9, "Looking after home or family", ifelse(data$W8DACTIVITYC == 10, "Something else", NA)))))))))))

data$W6acqno = as.factor(ifelse(data$W6acqno == 1, "First/Other Degree", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 2, "Other HE", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 3, "2+ A/AS", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 4, "1 A/AS", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 5, "5+ GCSE", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 6, "1-4 GCSE", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 7, "Other", ifelse(data$W6acqno == 9, "No academic study aim", NA)))))))))

data$W1empsmum = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 1, "Doing paid work for 30 or more hours a week", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 2, "Doing paid work for fewer than 30 hours a week", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 3, "Unemployed/ Looking for a job", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 4, "On a training course or scheme", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 5, "In full-time education/ at school", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 6, "Looking after the family/ household", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 7, "Retired from work altogether", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 8, "Sick/ disabled", ifelse(data$W1empsmum == 9, "Other", NA))))))))))

data$W1ethgrpYP = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 1, "White", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 2, "Mixed", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 3, "Indian", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 4, "Pakistani", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 5, "Bangladeshi", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 6, "Black Caribbean", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 7, "Black African", ifelse(data$W1ethgrpYP == 8, "Other", NA)))))))))

data$W8DMARSTAT = as.factor(ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 1, "Single and never married or in a CP", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 2, "Married", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 3, "Separated but still legally married", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 4, "Divorced", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 5, "Widowed", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 6, "A Civil Partner", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 7, "Separated but still legally in a CP", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 8, "A former Civil Partner", ifelse(data$W8DMARSTAT == 9, "A surviving Civil Partner", NA))))))))))

data$W1hiqualmum = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 1, "Higher Degree", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 2, "First Degree", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum ==3, "HE Diploma", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 4, "HNC/HND/NVQ4", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 5, "Teaching Qualification, non-degree", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 6, "Nursing qualification, non-degree", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 7, "A Levels", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 8, "OND/ONC", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 9, "City and guilds part III, NVQ3", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 10, "CSYS", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 11, "Scottish Higher Grade", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 12, "AS Level", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 13, "Trade apprenticeship", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 14, "City and guilds part II, NVQ2", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 15, "GCSE grade A-C and equivalent", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 16, "GCSE grade D-E and equivalent", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 17, "City and guilds part I, NVQ1", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 18, "Youth training, skill seekers", ifelse(data$W1hiqualmum == 19, "Qualification, level unspecified", NA))))))))))))))))))))


data$W1nssecfam = as.factor(ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 1, "Higher managerial and professional occupations", ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 2, "Lower managerial and professional occupations", ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 3, "Intermediate occupations", ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 4, "Small employers and own account workers", ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 5, "Lower supervisory and technical occupations", ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 6, "Semi-routine occupations", ifelse(data$W1nssecfam == 7, "Routine occupations", "Never worked/long term unemployed"))))))))
```



## Exploratory Analysis
### Dealing with NAs
```{r}
# colSums(is.na(data))
# colMeans(is.na(data))
missing_perc = colMeans(is.na(data))
var_keep = names(missing_perc[missing_perc<0.1])
data = data[complete.cases((data[, var_keep])), ]
```

```{r}
# convert NAs into "missing"
data$W1hiqualmum = as.character(data$W1hiqualmum)
data$W1hiqualmum = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(data$W1hiqualmum), "missing", data$W1hiqualmum))

data$W8DDEGP = as.character(data$W8DDEGP)
data$W8DDEGP = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(data$W8DDEGP), "missing", data$W8DDEGP))

data$W8TENURE = as.character(data$W8TENURE)
data$W8TENURE = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(data$W8TENURE), "missing", data$W8TENURE))

data$W6gcse = as.character(data$W6gcse)
data$W6gcse = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(data$W6gcse), "missing", data$W6gcse))

data$W8DAGEYCH = as.character(data$W8DAGEYCH)
data$W8DAGEYCH = as.factor(ifelse(is.na(data$W8DAGEYCH), "missing", data$W8DAGEYCH))
```


### Multicollinearity
We checked multicollinearity first by Wave and then by individual-specific cand familial backgrounds. 
# Wave 1
```{r}
W1_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1yschat1 + W1wrk1aMP + W1condur5MP + W1hea2MP + W1NoldBroHS + W1InCarHH + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH + W1hiqualmum + W1wrkfullmum + + W1empsmum + W1IndSchool + W1marstatmum + W1depkids + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1ethgrpYP + W1heposs9YP + W1hwndayYP + W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP, data)
# vif(W1_lm)
alias(W1_lm)

# W1wrkfullmum & W1empsmum
# Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1wrkfullmum + W1empsmum, data)) # indeed aliased coef.
Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1wrkfullmum, data)) # p-value 0.112
Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1empsmum, data)) # p-value 0.6418

lm_wrkfull = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1yschat1 + W1wrk1aMP + W1condur5MP + W1hea2MP + W1NoldBroHS + W1InCarHH + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH + W1hiqualmum + W1wrkfullmum + W1IndSchool + W1marstatmum + W1depkids + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1heposs9YP + W1ethgrpYP+ W1hwndayYP + W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP, data)
lm_emps = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1yschat1 + W1wrk1aMP + W1condur5MP + W1hea2MP + W1NoldBroHS + W1InCarHH + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH + W1hiqualmum + W1IndSchool + W1marstatmum + W1depkids + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1heposs9YP + W1hwndayYP + W1ethgrpYP+ W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP + W1empsmum, data)
Anova(lm_wrkfull)
Anova(lm_emps)
anova(lm_wrkfull, lm_emps, test = "Chisq")

data = subset(data, select = -W1empsmum)


W1_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1yschat1 + W1wrk1aMP + W1condur5MP + W1hea2MP + W1NoldBroHS + W1InCarHH + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH+ W1hiqualmum + W1wrkfullmum + W1IndSchool + W1marstatmum + W1depkids + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1heposs9YP + W1ethgrpYP+ W1hwndayYP + W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP, data)
vif(W1_lm)
data = subset(data, select = - W1wrk1aMP)

W1_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1yschat1 + W1condur5MP + W1hea2MP + W1NoldBroHS + W1InCarHH + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH+ W1hiqualmum + W1wrkfullmum + W1IndSchool + W1marstatmum + W1depkids + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1heposs9YP + W1ethgrpYP+ W1hwndayYP + W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP, data)
vif(W1_lm)
data = subset(data, select = - W1marstatmum)

W1_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1yschat1 + W1condur5MP + W1hea2MP + W1NoldBroHS + W1InCarHH + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH+ W1hiqualmum + W1wrkfullmum + W1IndSchool+ W1depkids + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1heposs9YP + W1ethgrpYP+ W1hwndayYP + W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP, data)
vif(W1_lm)
```

# Wave 2
```{r}
W2_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W2ghq12scr + W2disc1YP + W2depressYP, data)
vif(W2_lm)
```

# Wave 6
```{r}
W6_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W6JobYP + W6UnivYP + W6acqno + W6als + W6OwnchiDV + W6DebtattYP + W6gcse, data)
vif(W6_lm)

data = subset(data, select = -W6UnivYP)
W6_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W6JobYP + W6acqno + W6als + W6OwnchiDV + W6DebtattYP + W6gcse, data)
vif(W6_lm)

data = subset(data, select = -W6acqno)

W6_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W6JobYP + W6als + W6OwnchiDV + W6DebtattYP + W6gcse, data)
vif(W6_lm)
```

# Wave 8
```{r}
W8_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DINCW + W8DDEGP + W8DGHQSC + W8DMARSTAT + W8DACTIVITYC + W8DWRK + W8CMSEX + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI + W8DAGEYCH, data)
# vif(W8_lm) # aliased
alias(W8_lm)

# W8DACTIVITYC & W8DWRK
# Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DACTIVITYC + W8DWRK, data)) # indeed multicollinearity
Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DACTIVITYC, data)) # 0.7023
Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DWRK, data)) # 0.3193

lm_dactivity = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DINCW + W8DDEGP + W8DGHQSC + W8DMARSTAT + W8DACTIVITYC + W8CMSEX + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI + W8DAGEYCH, data)
lm_dwrk = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DINCW + W8DDEGP + W8DGHQSC + W8DMARSTAT + W8DWRK + W8CMSEX + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI + W8DAGEYCH, data)
Anova(lm_dwrk)
Anova(lm_dactivity)
anova(lm_dactivity, lm_dwrk, test = "Chisq")

data = subset(data, select = -W8DACTIVITYC)
W8_lm = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W8DINCW + W8DDEGP + W8DGHQSC + W8DMARSTAT + W8DWRK + W8CMSEX + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI + W8DAGEYCH, data)
vif(W8_lm)
```


# Check by groups 
```{r}
vif(lm(W8QDEB2 ~., data)) # overall, no huge multicollinearity

# check individual
lm_individual = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1hea2MP + W1ethgrpYP + W1heposs9YP + W1hwndayYP + W1truantYP + W1alceverYP + W1bulrc + W1disabYP + W1yschat1 + W2disc1YP + W2depressYP + W6JobYP + W6als + W6OwnchiDV + W6DebtattYP + W8DINCW + W8DDEGP + W8DGHQSC + W8DMARSTAT + W8DWRK + W8CMSEX + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI + W6gcse, data)
Anova(lm_individual)
vif(lm_individual)

# Check family
lm_family = lm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1GrssyrMP + W1condur5MP + W1InCarHH + W1NoldBroHS + W1hous12HH + W1usevcHH + W1hiqualmum + W1wrkfullmum + W1depkids + W1IndSchool + W1famtyp2 + W1nssecfam + W1ethgrpYP + W1disabYP + W8DWRK + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI + W8DAGEYCH, data)
Anova(lm_family)
vif(lm_family)
```


### Merge Levels
```{r}
# W2depressYP
ggplot(data, aes(x = W2depressYP, y = log(W8QDEB2+0.5))) + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip()
data$W2depressYP <- relevel(data$W2depressYP, ref = "Not at all")

levels(data$W2depressYP)[levels(data$W2depressYP) %in% c("Not at all", "No more than usual")] <- "Low"
levels(data$W2depressYP)[levels(data$W2depressYP) %in% c("Much more than usual", "Rather more than usual")] <- "High"


#W1hous12HH
summary(data$W1hous12HH)
ggplot(data, aes(x = W1hous12HH, y = log(W8QDEB2+0.5))) + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip()
data$W1hous12HH <- relevel(data$W1hous12HH, ref = "Owned outright")

levels(data$W1hous12HH)[levels(data$W1hous12HH) %in% c("Rent free", "Rented from a Council or New Town", "Rented from a Housing Association", "Rented privately", "Shared ownership (owns & rents property)", "Some other arrangement")] <- "Rented/Other"


# W1hiqualmum
ggplot(data, aes(x = W1hiqualmum, y = log(W8QDEB2+0.5))) + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip()
data$W1hiqualmum <- relevel(data$W1hiqualmum, ref = "Higher Degree")

levels(data$W1hiqualmum)[levels(data$W1hiqualmum) %in% c("Higher Degree", "First Degree", "HE Diploma", "HNC/HND/NVQ4", "OND/ONC")] <- "High"
levels(data$W1hiqualmum)[levels(data$W1hiqualmum) %in% c("A Levels", "Scottish Higher Grade", "CSYS", "City and guilds part III, NVQ3", "AS Level")] <- "Medium"
levels(data$W1hiqualmum)[levels(data$W1hiqualmum) %in% c("GCSE grade A-C and equivalent", "GCSE grade D-E and equivalent", "City and guilds part II, NVQ2")] <- "Low"
levels(data$W1hiqualmum)[levels(data$W1hiqualmum) %in% c("Youth training, skill seekers", "Trade apprenticeship", "Teaching Qualification, non-degree", "City and guilds part I, NVQ1", "Nursing qualification, non-degree", "Qualification, level unspecified")] <- "Very Low/Other"



# W1nssecfam
ggplot(data, aes(x = W1nssecfam, y = log(W8QDEB2+0.5))) + geom_boxplot()+coord_flip()
data$W1nssecfam = relevel(data$W1nssecfam, ref = "Never worked/long term unemployed")

levels(data$W1nssecfam)[levels(data$W1nssecfam) %in% c("Lower managerial and professional occupations", "Lower supervisory and technical occupations","Small employers and own account workers")] <- "Medium"
levels(data$W1nssecfam)[levels(data$W1nssecfam) %in% c("Semi-routine occupations","Routine occupations","Never worked/long term unemployed")] <- "Low"



# W1ethgrpYP
ggplot(data, aes(x = W1ethgrpYP, y = log(W8QDEB2+0.5))) + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip()
```

# Outlier Check
```{r}
owe.out<-lm(W8QDEB2 ~. ,data)
show_outliers <- function(the.linear.model, topN) { 
n = length(fitted(the.linear.model))
# number of parameters estimated
p = length(coef(the.linear.model))
# standardised residuals over 3
res.out <- which(abs(rstandard(the.linear.model)) > 3) 
# topN values
res.top <- head(rev(sort(abs(rstandard(the.linear.model)))), topN)
# high leverage values
lev.out <- which(lm.influence(the.linear.model)$hat > 2 * p/n)
# topN values
lev.top <- head(rev(sort(lm.influence(the.linear.model)$hat)), topN)
# high diffits
dffits.out <- which(dffits(the.linear.model) > 2 * sqrt(p/n))
# topN values
dffits.top <- head(rev(sort(dffits(the.linear.model))), topN)
# Cook's over 1
cooks.out <- which(cooks.distance(the.linear.model) > 1)
# topN cooks
cooks.top <- head(rev(sort(cooks.distance(the.linear.model))), topN)
# Create a list with the statistics -- cant do a data frame as different
# lengths
list.of.stats <- list(Std.res = res.out, Std.res.top = res.top, Leverage = lev.out,
        Leverage.top = lev.top, DFFITS = dffits.out, DFFITS.top = dffits.top,
Cooks = cooks.out, Cooks.top = cooks.top) 
list.of.stats
}
owe.out.stats<-show_outliers(owe.out, 10)
Reduce(intersect,list(owe.out.stats$DFFITS,owe.out.stats$Leverage))

common.out<-intersect(intersect(owe.out.stats$Std.res,owe.out.stats$DFFITS),
                      owe.out.stats$Leverage)
common.out # only 2 outliers

options(width = 100)
data[common.out,]


data_noOutlier = data[-common.out,]
Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~., data_noOutlier))
Anova(lm(W8QDEB2 ~., data)) # No big difference, keep it
```

# Create Binary variable & Modelling
```{r}
data1 = data
data1$W8QDEB2 = as.factor(ifelse(data1$W8QDEB2 <= median(data1$W8QDEB2), 0, 1))


glm_all = glm(W8QDEB2 ~., data1, family = binomial)
summary(glm_all) # 4169.6, AIC: 4277.6
Anova(glm_all)

owe.out.stats<-show_outliers(glm_all, 10)
common.out<-intersect(intersect(owe.out.stats$Std.res,owe.out.stats$DFFITS),
                      owe.out.stats$Leverage)
common.out # 0 outlier


glm_filtered = glm(W8QDEB2 ~ W1yschat1 + W1hous12HH + W1wrkfullmum + W1famtyp2 + 
                     W1nssecfam + W1alceverYP + W6JobYP + W6DebtattYP + 
                     W8DDEGP + W8DGHQSC + W8DMARSTAT + W8DWRK + W8TENURE + W8QMAFI, 
                   data1, family = binomial)

owe.out.stats<-show_outliers(glm_filtered, 10)
common.out<-intersect(intersect(owe.out.stats$Std.res,owe.out.stats$DFFITS),
                      owe.out.stats$Leverage)
common.out # 0 outlier


Anova(glm_filtered)
summary(glm_filtered) # 4209.7, AIC: 4259.7
anova(glm_all, glm_filtered, test = "Chisq") # glm_all is even better, at 5%


glm_reduced = glm(W8QDEB2 ~. - W1InCarHH - W1heposs9YP - W1IndSchool - W2ghq12scr - W1disabYP - W1hiqualmum - W6OwnchiDV - W2disc1YP - W8DINCW - W1hwndayYP - W1bulrc - W1depkids - W6gcse - W1usevcHH - W1NoldBroHS, data1, family = binomial)
anova(glm_reduced, glm_all, test = "Chisq") # statistically, no difference
anova(glm_reduced, glm_filtered, test = "Chisq") # statistically better at 0.1%
Anova(glm_reduced)
summary(glm_reduced) # 4184.5, AIC: 4252.5
# this is the most significantly better model compared to glm_filtered 
# only has p-value lower than 0.2
# tried to reduce the model even further, Chisq p-value will be increased, so stick with this


owe.out.stats<-show_outliers(glm_reduced, 10)
common.out<-intersect(intersect(owe.out.stats$Std.res,owe.out.stats$DFFITS),
                      owe.out.stats$Leverage)
common.out # 0 outlier
```

```{r}
glm_int = glm(W8QDEB2 ~. - W1InCarHH - W1heposs9YP - W1IndSchool - W2ghq12scr - W1disabYP - W1hiqualmum - W6OwnchiDV - W2disc1YP - W8DINCW - W1hwndayYP - W1bulrc - W1depkids - W6gcse - W1usevcHH - W1NoldBroHS + W6JobYP * W8CMSEX, data1, family = binomial)

Anova(glm_int) 
summary(glm_int) # 4179.8 , AIC: 4249.8
anova(glm_int, glm_reduced, test = "Chisq") # significantly better at 1%
anova(glm_int, glm_all, test = "Chisq")
```

# Interpretation of the results
```{r}
invlogit(coef(glm_int))
base_line = invlogit(coef(glm_int)[1])
summary(glm_int)
live_quite_difficult = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (-0.84383)) # Quite difficult
live_just = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (-1.00195)) # JUST ABOUT GETTING BY
live_comfort = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (-1.56266)) # LIVE COMFORTABLY
live_alright = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (-1.38423)) # DOING ALRIGHT
change_liveComfort = (live_comfort-base_line)/base_line


male = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (-0.29231)) # Male
gender_change = (male-base_line)/base_line # change from female to male
RRatio_gender = male/base_line # risk ratio, female to male, keeping everything else constant


tenure_buyWLoan = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (0.98194)) # TENURE -- buy with loan
change_tenure = (tenure_buyWLoan - base_line)/base_line

# debt attitude 7 vs. 18
summary(data1$W6DebtattYP)
debt7 = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (0.05116  * 7)) # Debatte
debt15 = invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + (0.05116 * 15))
RRatio = debt15/debt7 # risk ratio, attitude 7 to 15

invlogit(glm_int$coefficients[1] + 0.28182 + (-0.29231) + (0.32689)) # Interaction Term
```


## Classification Table -- Median as the Threshold
```{r}
ct.op<-function(predicted,observed){ 
#create the data frame  
df.op<-data.frame(predicted=predicted,observed=observed)
#create a table 
op.tab<-table(df.op)
#use the prop.table function to obtain the proportions we need:
#those who were correctly predicted as 0 
#@position 1,1 in the table of proportions
obs0.tab<-round(prop.table(op.tab,2)[1,1],2)
#those who were correctly predicted as 1
#@position 2,2 in the table of proportions
obs1.tab<-round(prop.table(op.tab,2)[2,2],2)
#and put them under the table 
op.tab<-rbind(op.tab,c(obs0.tab,obs1.tab))
#name the rows
rownames(op.tab)<-c("pred=0","pred=1","%corr")
#name the columns
colnames(op.tab)<-c("obs=0","obs=1")
#return the table
op.tab
}

pred.pk<-as.numeric(glm_int$fitted.values>0.5)
#pass the fitted values and the observed values to ct.op
ct.op(pred.pk,data1$W8QDEB2)
```
